detail.recoveryHint: Earliest and latest are UTC event times. A break means you cannot treat this chain as one continuous restore.
detail.storageAlert: Stored binlog does not match the checkpoint
detail.storageAlertSegment: Damaged segment: {segment}. It has a rotate to an older file or an event position that goes backwards.
detail.storageAlertMissing: Transactions the checkpoint lists that no segment holds: {gtids}.
detail.storageAlertNoValid: No segment before {segment} is left to restore.
detail.storageAlertValidOne: The segment before {segment} ({first}) was written before the damage and still restores.
detail.storageAlertValid: The {count} segments before {segment} ({first} to {last}) were written before the damage and still restore.
detail.storageAlertNext: Do not start this task again and do not restore the damaged segment or any later one. Replay from this task stops before it. Create a new task from a GTID the source still has.
detail.storageAlertRestart: Start the new task in GTID mode with gtid_set {gtids}. It continues right after those segments and fetches the missing transactions again. Do it before the source purges them.
detail.recoveryBreaks: This backup chain has a break
detail.replayDamaged: Segment {segment} is damaged. It and every later segment are left out of this replay.
detail.pitrHint: Times are UTC, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Stop GTID is server_uuid:sequence. Executed GTID set is the restored backup's gtid_executed and cannot be combined with a start time. Restore your own full backup first, then pipe this command into the restore server.
detail.replayFlavorUnset: Source flavor is unset. Pass these paths to MySQL mysqlbinlog or mariadb-binlog.
detail.bucketOnly: A segment marked bucket is not on this disk. Download the segment or the replay set; those bytes come from the bucket. Do not pass that path to mysqlbinlog until the file is downloaded.
detail.noCheckpoint: None. The next Start uses the configured start.
detail.pendingDumpCleanup: source Binlog Dump connection {id} may still be open; will KILL when source is reachable
detail.pendingDumpCleanupProcessLocal: Only this process (the worker that held the dump) shows this warning. A restart clears it. Other processes see it after migration 000004.
detail.sourceChainHint: Each stint is one server writing its own binlog files. Current is the server that wrote the newest files; when the task is stopped it is not copying it. The first server keeps the source file name. A later stint's files start with that server's identity, or identity~n when the task returns to a server it copied before (failback).
detail.sourceContinuedTitle: This task kept copying after the address moved to another server
detail.sourceContinuedBody: The task is still running. Check that the recoverable window is continuous, and that a replay lists the older server's files before the newer server's files.
detail.sourceStoppedNext: Start a new task against the new primary and keep this backup. Leave the .source-chain file in the task directory. Starting this task again will not mix the two servers.

switchReason.no_gtid: This backup has no GTID set, so the old file and position cannot be applied on the new server.
switchReason.missing_transactions: The new primary is missing transactions this backup already has.
switchReason.purged: The new primary has purged transactions this backup does not have yet, so they cannot be copied.
switchReason.mariadb: MariaDB has no usable GTID path for a source switch.
switchReason.gtid_unreadable: The new source GTID state could not be read.
switchReason.unknown: This backup cannot continue on the new server without mixing the two servers.
